purpose: Add explicit local recovery snapshots for the canonical profile database so a corrupt live DB can be inspected and restored by exact hash without silent fallback or loss of the pre-restore evidence.

lineage.outcome: The artist can explicitly restore a verified local canonical-memory snapshot after corruption and resume the same Song state represented by that restore point.

completion_proof: snapshot uses SQLite backup into a temporary same-profile recovery file and is integrity/profile checked before atomic replacement
snapshot has an exact SHA-256 that is required for restore
normal HeadquartersMemory.open continues to fail visibly on a corrupt live DB even while a valid snapshot exists
inspect_snapshot works without opening or mutating the live canonical database
wrong restore hash refuses before replacing live state
explicit exact-hash restore preserves the current/corrupt database before installing the verified snapshot
restored profile reopens with the exact Artist/Song/version/evidence state present at snapshot and not post-snapshot mutations
a snapshot copied under another profile is rejected by embedded profile identity
failure while replacing a newly-created snapshot cannot destroy the previous valid snapshot
unreadable snapshot returns a bounded validation failure rather than an internal/uninitialized error
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01F proof, reconcile evidence and globally reselect. Do not continue reliability/backup work by adjacency.
